title: Subtract roasted batches from green inventory
body: Right now the script only adds stock. It should also read the roast logs from `roast-profile-logger` (batch kg) and subtract them, so the LOW warnings are accurate.

title: Import Highland Imports Oct 28 shipment when it lands
body: Tom Becker confirmed 6 bags Yirgacheffe + 4 bags Huila, shipping Oct 28 and arriving Nov 3. Run `sync.py shipments/highland-2026-10-28.json` on arrival and check the weights against the delivery note.
